mapper.select: SELECT * FROM FILES WHERE FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'NAMECARD' AND FILE_SOURCE_ID = #{mbrCd} AND DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD' ORDER BY REG_DTM DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FILES ( FILE_ID, FILE_ATTACH_SEQ, FILE_SOURCE_REF, FILE_SOURCE_ID, FILE_ORIGINALNAME, FILE_SAVEDNAME, FILE_MIME, FILE_DIR, FILE_SIZE, DOC_TYPE_CD, FILE_PATH_URL, REG_DTM ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{fileAttachSeq}, #{fileSourceRef}, #{fileSourceId}, #{fileOriginalname}, #{fileSavedname}, #{fileMime}, #{fileDir}, #{fileSize}, #{docTypeCd}, #{filePathUrl}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE FILES SET DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD' WHERE FILE_SOURCE_ID = #{mbrCd} AND DOC_TYPE_CD = 'NAMECARD_MAIN'
